name: ElevenLabs Speak
description: Have your phone read remote output aloud: pipe a command's output — an agent log, a test summary, a diff — through ElevenLabs text-to-speech. Sends your API key and the text to api.elevenlabs.io.
author: Mobile SSH

settings.label: ElevenLabs API key
settings.help: Create one at elevenlabs.io → Profile → API keys. Stored encrypted on this device (Keychain / Keystore) and sent only to api.elevenlabs.io. The key needs Text to Speech and Voices read permission.

settings.label: Model
settings.help: Turbo is the cheapest and fastest and is what you want for reading logs. Multilingual v2 sounds better and costs about twice as much per character.

settings.label: Audio quality
settings.help: How much mobile data each spoken line costs. 22 kHz/32 kbps is roughly 4 KB per second of speech and is fine for voice; 44 kHz/128 kbps is four times the data.

settings.label: Save clips to (on the server)
settings.help: Folder on the connected host where ⬇ Save writes the MP3; it is created if missing. Use the app's File Transfer screen to copy clips to the phone. Letters, digits and . _ - / ~ only.

settings.label: Max characters per request
settings.help: ElevenLabs bills per character, so a 40 000-character log tail spoken by accident is a real bill. Anything longer than this is cut at a sentence boundary and the plugin tells you how much it dropped.
